description: Lifecycle Declaration 合同 - Manifest 声明与执行的边界

manifestOwns.description: Manifest.LifecycleMeta 声明 Lifecycle 偏好

lifecycleSystemOwns.description: Extension Kernel Lifecycle 执行实际生命周期操作

runtimeSupervisorOwns.description: RuntimeSupervisor 持有实际运行时状态

principles: Runtime Supervisor = track actual runtime state
Manifest 不持有 running/failed/degraded 等运行时状态

providerLifecycle.description: Provider (Model/Voice) 生命周期通过 Extension Lifecycle 管理
providerLifecycle.initialize: Extension Install -> Provider Contribution 注册
providerLifecycle.health: Runtime Adapter / Provider Health Check (NOT Manifest)
providerLifecycle.stop: Extension Disable/Uninstall -> Provider Contribution 卸载
providerLifecycle.note: Provider 不引入独立 Lifecycle 引擎

manifestStatePrinciple.description: Manifest 只有 valid/invalid 解析结果

status: ALREADY_SUPPORTED - Manifest/Lifecycle/State 三层分离已实现
